descricao: ONE golden table for the Diretor de Criação's `### Publicação <n>` block (criacao-pipeline-contract 2.3/4). The agents side (products/agents/backend/app/criacao/saida.py, tests/criacao/test_publicacao_golden.py) must extract exactly `agents.numeros` and report exactly `agents.falhas` (checar_publicacao codes); the social-wiring side (modules/media_creation/services/publicacoes.py, tests/modules/media_creation/test_criacao_publicacao_golden.py) must accept exactly `sw.validas` and count `sw.invalidas`. The two sides differ BY DESIGN on `link_preenchido`: the agent's output check flags a filled Link, SW never reads it (the owner pastes the URL by hand). Add a case to both suites or to neither.
